components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action on a surface; used once per decision point.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--secondary, #0f766e); color: #fff; padding: 12px 28px; min-height: 48px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font: 700 16px Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s ease, transform .2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--act-navy, #011221); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--secondary, #0f766e); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action paired with the primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: var(--secondary, #0f766e); padding: 12px 28px; min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid var(--secondary, #0f766e); border-radius: 999px; font: 700 16px Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s ease, color .2s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--secondary, #0f766e); color: #fff; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--secondary, #0f766e); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Category filter; selected state carries the active voice.
components.css: .ds-chip { background: var(--tint, #f7f2e9); color: var(--secondary, #0f766e); padding: 0 16px; min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid var(--mist, #e8e1d7); border-radius: 999px; font: 700 14px Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--secondary, #0f766e); color: #fff; border-color: var(--secondary, #0f766e); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--secondary, #0f766e); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
This is a quietly systematic record of community-led work, not a campaign shell. The interface recedes so the field material leads: program chapters, location labels, captioned photographs and consented voices. Structure is obvious, vocabulary is plain, and nothing asks the visitor to admire the interface instead of the work.

The archive character favors calm surfaces, disciplined spacing and a small, consistent set of controls. Depth is restrained and tactile: elements lie flat at rest and lift only slightly in response to interaction. Type carries hierarchy through scale and weight rather than decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Documentary imagery from the field, always captioned and situated by location.
Clear archival structure: program → chapter → place → moment.
One active accent (teal) with gold reserved for emphasis and provenance.
Flat surfaces, soft offset hover shadows, pill-shaped controls.
Mobile-first, accessible, and honest about missing evidence.

rules.name: The One Active Voice Rule
rules.body: Teal owns interaction: links, selected chips, focus, buttons. Gold marks provenance and emphasis; ember appears only in impact statistics.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: The storybook stays cream paper in both themes. Dark mode never repaints the book.

rules.name: The Balanced Heading Rule
rules.body: Headings use balanced wrapping; never ship a heading that leaves a single orphan word.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces sit flat until hover, focus or elevation is meaningful.

dos: Do lead with real field photography and caption it with location.
Do keep the secondary accent exclusively for interactive state.
Do keep reading columns near 75ch and headings balanced.
Do theme selection, caret and scrollbars from the palette.
donts: Don't invent impact numbers, quotes or testimonials.
Don't use hard offset shadows, gradient text or colored borders thicker than 1px on cards and callouts.
Don't repaint the storybook paper in dark mode.
Don't let decorative motion obscure content or skip reduced-motion users.
